name: Tomelloso (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over green in the proportions 2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tomelloso (a tree and a dog on green) and in the upper hoist with a red cross of Saint James.
history: Municipal flag of Tomelloso; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Tomelloso arms — tree and dog on green
cross of Saint James in the upper hoist
